# Provenance: nozzle, surface and material fixtures (PRF-5)

- Source: hand-written JSON for this module, in the entity shapes of `docs/research/profiles.md` §6 (lines 209-215, 223-230). Individual numbers and ids were read from upstream data (facts only, no file or text copied); commits: `PrusaSlicer-2.9@b028299`, `OrcaSlicer@09aa0114`, `Cura@5bea2f8`, `fdm_materials@0c05969`.
- Licence of the studied sources: PrusaSlicer and OrcaSlicer profiles AGPL-3.0, Cura LGPL-3.0, fdm_materials a Creative Commons licence (see its LICENSE). The fixtures themselves are our own work.
- `printer-model-prusa-xl.json`: `retract_length` 0.8 and 0.7 for the 0.4 and 0.6 nozzles come from `PrusaSlicer-2.9@b028299:resources/profiles/PrusaResearch.ini:40163` (`*commonXL*`) and `:40296` (`[printer:Original Prusa XL 0.6 nozzle]`). The per-nozzle presets of the INI become one `printer_model` plus `nozzle` entities plus an `overrides` block (research lines 180-181, 230). Bed and kinematics are illustrative.
- `surface-cura-glass.json`: from `Cura@5bea2f8:resources/variants/ultimaker_s5_glass.inst.cfg` (`hardware_type = buildplate`, `machine_buildplate_type = glass`, `material_bed_temperature = =default_material_bed_temperature`, kept as an `{expr}` value).
- `surface-orca-*.json`: plate-temperature keys with the values of `OrcaSlicer@09aa0114:resources/profiles/BBL/filament/fdm_filament_pla.json` (`cool_plate_temp` 35 at line 16, `textured_plate_temp` 55 at line 107).
- `material-bambu-pla-basic.json`: `filament_id` `OFoiVqVM`, density 1.26, cost 15.99, flow ratio 0.98 from `OrcaSlicer@09aa0114:resources/profiles/BBL/filament/Bambu PLA Basic @base.json:6-18`; nozzle temperature 220 from `Bambu PLA Basic @BBL X1C.json`. The Cura GUID is that of Generic PLA (`fdm_materials@0c05969:generic_pla.xml.fdm_material:12`), `orca_filament_id` `OFDSrzZ8` is `OrcaSlicer@09aa0114:resources/profiles/BBL/filament/Generic PLA @base.json:6`, `prusa_name` is the INI section at `PrusaResearch.ini:36455`. The four ids are mixed on purpose to test storage; they do not claim these are the same material. Currency USD and 1.75 mm diameter are assumptions (unverified).
- Created 2026-10-26.
